title: Sum Through a Callback
prompt: Implement `void foreach_int(const int *a, size_t n, void (*fn)(int v, void *ctx), void *ctx)` calling fn once per element, and use it to implement `long long sum_with_ctx(const int *a, size_t n)` which totals the array through a stack-allocated context struct — no globals. The ctx pattern is the point.

tests.name: sums correctly
tests.hint: The ctx accumulator collects every callback visit; 1-2+3-4+5 = 3.

tests.name: empty is zero
tests.hint: n = 0 must survive: zero visits, ctx total stays 0.
